# Sanket Tambare — Personal Site

> Software Development Engineer, endurance runner, fort-trekker, and writer based in Pune, India. This site is a personal portfolio and digital archive — books read, races run, treks completed, blog posts published, and projects shipped.

## About

- [About](https://sankettambare.in/about): Full-stack software developer, ultra-marathoner, fort-trekker, and writer. Background, interests, and what drives him.
- [Now](https://sankettambare.in/now): What Sanket is working on right now — current projects, daily rituals, books in progress, and ideas being explored. Updated monthly.
- [Resume](https://sankettambare.in/resume): Professional background — full-stack engineer with experience in cloud infrastructure, AI integration, and enterprise software. Work history, education, and certifications.
- [Contact](https://sankettambare.in/contact): Contact information for collaboration on technology, endurance sports, or research.

## Content

- [Books](https://sankettambare.in/books): Interactive catalog of 100+ books read, with reviews spanning design, philosophy, technology, and Marathi literature.
- [Sports / Races](https://sankettambare.in/sports): Race logs, marathon results, and performance stats from 10 K to Full Marathon — tracking every kilometre from 2023 onwards.
- [Treks](https://sankettambare.in/treks): Trek log across Maharashtra's historic forts and mountain trails — with statistics, difficulty breakdowns, yearly timelines, and detailed route stories.
- [Projects](https://sankettambare.in/projects): Full-stack experiments and production apps — social platforms, AI-powered tools, and web applications built with modern tech stacks.
- [Presentations](https://sankettambare.in/presentations): Talks, dossiers and data stories built as HTML slide decks, viewable in place.
- [100 Days To Offload](https://sankettambare.in/100-days-to-offload): Following the #100DaysToOffload challenge — publishing 100 blog posts in a year, with progress tracking and interactive filtering of every post.
- [Micro Blog](https://sankettambare.in/micro-blog): Searchable archive of 1 600+ short posts, quotes, and captures imported from Tumblr — years of thoughts, one micro-post at a time.
- [Instagram](https://sankettambare.in/instagram): Curated visual archive of captured moments, textures, and stories — preserved from before the Instagram account was deleted.

## Meta

- [Stats](https://sankettambare.in/stats): Metrics of Intent — a quantitative deep-dive into a year of technical growth, artistic captures, and consistent physical output.
- [Challenges](https://sankettambare.in/challenges): Tracking personal challenges like #100DaysToOffload — public commitment to consistent creative output.
- [Interactive Me](https://sankettambare.in/interactive-me): Shuffled, image-first visual timeline of every marathon run and mountain trek.
- [Mind Map](https://sankettambare.in/mindmap): Interactive mindmap of everything on the site — books, marathons, treks, projects, and blogs.
- [Changelog](https://sankettambare.in/changelog): Transparent record of every meaningful change made to this website.

## Optional

- [agents.md](https://sankettambare.in/agents.md): Extended structured context about this site intended for AI agents, LLMs, and automated crawlers.
